module: Flowgraph node "PointsBar Thresholds" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Defines the bronze, silver and gold thresholds (number inputs) of the points bar via ui_apps_pointsBar.setThresholds({bronze, silver, gold}), then sets self.mgr.modules.ui.pointsBarChanged to true.

work.desc: Calls ui_apps_pointsBar.setThresholds with the three thresholds and signals the change to the flowgraph ui module.
